notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Fixed, "Reinforced" and "Forgive Gicu" Achievements not triggering.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the flowers puzzle was being skipped by pressing tab.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.notes:
- Reduced the Mutated entities' health by 30%
- Added more ammo in levels featuring them.

Sadly, entities in already existing saves won't have their health updated for that level.

notes.title: Update 1.02 + Achievements
notes.notes:
- Added 3840x2160 Resolution
- Added a piece of paper to help with the statues/ harp puzzle
- 8 Achievements have been added

notes.title: Minecart Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed the minecart's speed. It was accidentally set to 10x faster than it should have been.

notes.title: Odyssey to the Frozen Legion is available now!
notes.notes: [p]Odyssey to the Frozen Legion has been released! You can now purchase the game on its Steam page.[/p][p]It has been a long time coming, and after a lot of effort, it is finally done.[/p][p]I truly hope you all like the game, and I thank you![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Odyssey to the Frozen Legion - Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes: [p]I am very excited to finally be able to tell everyone when the game is coming out. After roughly two years and several internal delays, my game will be released on August 8th.[/p][p][/p][p]It took a lot of effort to design and create this game while attending university, but I hope you will like it.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="xVvMQI8I6X8;full"][/previewyoutube]
